verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that Deel runs payroll and exposes generic 'time data' and time-off requests through its MCP server. Nothing documents hourly time entries or overtime calculations feeding into a payroll run. Time-off requests and payroll processing are adjacent capabilities, not this one, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can have hourly time entries and overtime flow directly into the payroll run
